backlogged.summary: reproProgram lowercases the program name before the event is redacted at write time. If a repro's first word is itself a secret environment value that contains uppercase letters (for example `$ABC_TOKEN_VALUE arg` written out as a literal), the lowercased form no longer matches the redactor's exact value. The lowercased secret is then stored in repro_program. To reproduce, the evaluator has to put a literal secret in the program position. A fix would be to redact before cmdName lowercases, or to apply clip() to repro_program.

repro_program has no length cap and does not go through clip(). The other free-text event fields (criterion_id, dimension, summary, problems) are redacted and then cut. Applying clip(reproProgram(...), EVENT_ID_CHARS) would cover both issues.

In the critical eval_error path, where the evaluator's reply fails the schema twice while the reviewer succeeds, the reviewer's security/finding events are flushed without `unused: true`. No test covers this.

evalErr flushes eval/verdict and security/verdict events after finishError has written the eval_error file. A concurrent evaluation of the same round writes these events twice. Nothing deduplicates by round the way refuseExisting does for pass/fail verdicts.
